manual_review: Extra payment(s): Essential car user
We are recruiting a Building Maintenance Surveyor to join the Operations and Maintenance team in Crawley Homes.
This key technical role supports the delivery of high-quality repairs, maintenance and improvement works across our housing stock and associated buildings.

As a Building Maintenance Surveyor, you will be responsible for the day-to-day responsive repairs and programmed inspection, diagnosis and management of building maintenance work across an allocated area.
This includes domestic housing, leasehold properties, sheltered accommodation, hostels and public buildings.
carry out property inspections, surveys and defect diagnosis
prepare drawings, specifications and cost estimates
supervise contractors and administer building contracts
certify works and payments and manage quality on site
deal with customer enquiries, complaints and disrepair claims
support asset data updates and statutory compliance
We are seeking an experienced, customer-focused surveyor who can work under pressure, manage multiple workstreams and communicate effectively with tenants, leaseholders, contractors and colleagues.
Essential requirements include:
strong building inspection and defect diagnosis skills across multiple trades
ability to prepare specifications, drawings and cost estimates
knowledge of housing repairs, maintenance and planned works
understanding of health & safety, building regulations and relevant legislation
good IT skills, including works ordering and asset management systems
Qualifications / Experience:
RICS or CIOB building surveying certificate or working towards it
relevant construction, building surveying or property qualification
experience in building maintenance, repairs and contract supervision
budgetary control and certification experience
Experience in local authority or housing association maintenance and working within partnering contracts is desirable.
Why join Crawley Homes?
You’ll be joining a team committed to maintaining and improving homes, placing customers at the heart of the service, and supporting professional development within a collaborative environment.
Additional information
Satisfactory clearance of a Basic Disclosure and Barring Service check (DBS) will be a condition of employment.
Essential car user car allowance (currently under review).
Occasional out-of-hours working may be required.
Crawley is a great place to work, with a thriving business district and excellent transport connections including nearby Gatwick Airport.
We are based in our modern Town Hall which opened in 2023 and is located a short walk from the town centre and railway station.
Employee benefits
We offer a generous employee benefits package, with a range of discounts, benefits and wellbeing incentives to suit everyone.
At Crawley Borough Council, you will have access to a structured programme of learning from day one, designed to help you succeed in your role and grow your career.
Local government reorganisation
Local government reorganisation (LGR) is planned across Sussex, with new unitary authorities expected by 2028.
While this represents a significant change for councils, most roles will continue to focus on delivering vital services to our residents and business communities.
As the future structure evolves, our name may change, but our commitment to providing excellent services and supporting our employees will not.
Joining us now means being part of a dedicated team during an important and evolving time for local government.
Our way of working
Our shared values and behaviours reflect the special nature of our council.
We encourage all colleagues to put them into practice, whatever job they do.
Take a look to see if we are the perfect match.
Safer recruitment
Crawley Borough Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.
We want to be an inclusive and diverse employer of first choice reflecting the community we serve and particularly welcome applications from all under represented groups.

manual_review: Salary: £60,000 - £68,000 – (depending on experience)
Please note that both a CV and a cover letter are required for any application detailing how you meet the person specification for the role as well as answering the below questions:
Core Accountabilities
Define architecture patterns and technical roadmaps
Work with service designers refining user stories and new requirements
Design and develop plugins, APIs, integrations and customisations using C# and JavaScript
Lead Dataverse, model-driven app design
Provide technical governance and code review oversight
Guide DevOps, release management and testing standards
Mentor developers and support capability growth
Essential Experience
Strong expertise in Dataverse, model-driven app development and solution design.
Experience designing and delivering integrations using APIs, Azure services and middleware technologies.
Experience implementing DevOps best practices, CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and leadership skills.
Experience mentoring and leading technical teams.
Desirable Experience
Experience developing Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Pages solutions.
Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and cloud-first design principles.
Experience working within Agile, Scrum or multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
Experience delivering solutions within regulated or large-scale public sector environments.
Knowledge of AI Builder, Copilot Studio and emerging Microsoft AI capabilities.
Experience overseeing technical delivery across multiple workstreams or product teams.
Understanding of data migration, data governance and master data management approaches.
Additional Information
For many appointments within the CAA, these roles require access to operationally sensitive infrastructure and/or Nationally Protected information.
For these roles the post holders must undergo National Security Vetting and achieve the appropriate level of clearance.
SC - To be vetted we will usually expect a reasonable period of residency in the UK so that meaningful checks can be undertaken.
For this role this will need to be 5 years.
If you do not meet these requirements, we may not be able to accept your application.
For more information on CTC and SC clearance please visit - Vetting explained - GOV.UK (www.gov.uk)
The CAA values high ethical standards and personal integrity among employees.
If invited for interview you will be asked to complete a declaration of interest.
Relocation & Property
The CAA will be relocating from Aviation House (Our Gatwick Office) to new premises in a few years’ time.
Our move is driven by strategic, operational and environmental considerations.
We will be moving to a new local home, up to a 15-mile radius of Aviation House, to minimise disruption for our valued colleagues and customers.
We are now working with colleagues and visitors to understand what we need in our new office, before we start our property search.
We will sell Aviation House and land, vacate the site and move to new premises, but we do not expect to move before 2028
Inclusive Recruitment
If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
Use of Artificial Intelligence by candidates in the CAA recruitment process
No recruitment agencies please.

We recognise that many of our candidates find Artificial Intelligence to be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience.
Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be rejected on that basis.
Working With Us
Explore What We Offer section on our careers website to find out about our benefits and how we support work-life balance.
Our Values
Do The Right Thing, Never Stop Learning, Build Collaborative Relationships, Respect Everyone – For more information please Click Here
Closing Date: Friday 23rd October 2026
Screening Calls: w/c Monday 2nd November 2026
Interview Date: w/c 9th & 16th November 2026
We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role.
Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

manual_review: Personal Assistant (5649)
Salary: £35,000 to £40,000 dependent upon experience
You will be providing a high‑quality, proactive, and confidential level of executive support to up to two Group Directors.

Whilst often working independently, you will be an integral part of a wider administrative support team and will work collaboratively to coordinate and manage delivery of the designated Group Director(s) priorities.

You will also operate with minimum supervision, utmost confidentiality and deliver timely inputs to corporate processes and reports, the non-delivery of which could have a significant impact on the reputation of the CAA, the Group and Director (s).
Core Accountabilities
Manage and prioritise inboxes, correspondence, and meeting requests, identifying urgent or time‑critical matters and taking appropriate action in the absence of the Director(s).

The varied nature of the role requires you to be able to continually review and re-prioritise tasks, according to changing business needs, whilst delivering outputs to the required quality and timescales.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
Understanding of organisational priorities
Maintain regular contact with Director(s) while they are travelling or working remotely, escalating urgent issues when required.
Track progress of key deliverables linked to Business Plans and ensure timely updates to the Director(s).
Undertake ad‑hoc projects and tasks as required.
The role requires a flexible approach and the ability to take on new tasks as and when business priorities change, anticipating what is coming and making sure the Director is properly prepared.
Strong judgement and initiative is essential, including knowing what needs the Director’s attention and what you can resolve yourself.

You will understand the importance of the Group Director’s senior leadership team and be part of supporting the Group Director in developing that team, acting as a sounding board as required and maintaining their complete trust.
Strong administrative background, ideally supporting senior leaders.
Proven ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
Excellent diary and inbox management skills.
Confidence using modern digital tools, especially high proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Discreet, trustworthy, and able to handle confidential information.
Calm and professional when faced with urgent demands.
Team-oriented with the ability to collaborate across departments.
Proactive and anticipatory support: the ability to anticipate what is coming and make sure the Director is properly prepared
commitment to delivering a high standard of professional service in a courteous and collaborative manner
Strong judgement and initiative, including knowing what needs the Director’s attention and what they can resolve themselves.
Ownership of tracking decisions, commitments, and actions, and proactively chasing them through.
Have worked in a Regulatory environment
Interest in Aviation & Aerospace
Event planning and co-ordination
Budget and expenses management
Additional Information
For many appointments within the CAA, these roles require access to operationally sensitive infrastructure and/or Nationally Protected information.
For these roles the post holders must undergo National Security Vetting and achieve the appropriate level of clearance.
To be vetted you must have the right to work in the UK so that meaningful checks can be undertaken.
If you do not meet these requirements, we may not be able to accept your application.
For more information on BPSS clearance please visit - BPSS clearance
The CAA is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct.

To help ensure transparency and protect the independence and reputation of the CAA, candidates invited to interview will be required to complete a Declaration of Interests form, disclosing any actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest that could influence, or be seen to influence, their ability to perform the role objectively and impartially.
Relocation & Property
The CAA will be relocating from Aviation House (Our Gatwick Office) to new premises in a few years’ time.
Our move is driven by strategic, operational and environmental considerations.
We will be moving to a new local home, up to a 15-mile radius of Aviation House, to minimise disruption for our valued colleagues and customers.
We are now working with colleagues and visitors to understand what we need in our new office, before we start our property search.
We will sell Aviation House and land, vacate the site and move to new premises, but we do not expect to move before 2028
Inclusive Recruitment
If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
Use of Artificial Intelligence by candidates in the CAA recruitment process
No recruitment agencies please.

We recognise that many of our candidates find Artificial Intelligence to be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience.
Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be rejected on that basis.
Working With Us
Explore What We Offer section on our careers website to find out about our benefits and how we support work-life balance.
Our Values
Do The Right Thing, Never Stop Learning, Build Collaborative Relationships, Respect Everyone – For more information please Click Here
Closing Date: 4 Nov 2026
Interview Date: From 10 Nov 2026 – In Person Gatwick

manual_review: Occupational Health support.
Employee Assistance Programme.
You will be part of a small team responsible for preparing and administering customer connection agreements, including agreed changes such as reductions in available capacity.

You will act as a point of contact for customers and their representatives, maintain accurate connection records and help ensure activities meet regulatory, data protection and confidentiality requirements.
Handle personal and commercially sensitive information in line with data protection, UK GDPR and confidentiality requirements.
Understanding of the importance of data protection, confidentiality and the appropriate handling of sensitive information.
Your organisation, accuracy and clear communication will help customers receive timely information and ensure agreement records are complete and up to date.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information and options in an accessible way.
Prepare and administer customer connection agreements and agreed variations.
Respond to customer and representative enquiries by email and telephone about the standing data held in their agreements.
Follow relevant regulatory requirements and team processes when completing connection agreement activities.
Five GCSEs at grades 9-4 or A*-C, including English and Mathematics, or equivalent qualifications or relevant practical experience.
Confidence using Microsoft Excel and Word to manage information and produce documents.
Attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
Experience in customer data management, contract administration or a similar coordination role.
Experience of the UK energy sector or another regulated environment.
We recognise that strong candidates may bring relevant skills through different career paths.
If you meet most of the essential criteria and believe your transferable experience could make you successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.
Health & Safety Responsibilities

Managers and supervisors carry both legal and company responsibilities for ensuring the health and safety of their employees, those under their control and those who might be affected by the work undertaken, i.e.
public, visitors and employees of other organisations.
This includes briefing individuals working for them and ensuring there is the necessary understanding, competence and application of requirements to work safely and without harming the environment.

Employees will ensure they fully understand the health and safety risks involved in their work activities and their responsibility to apply the controls needed to manage those risks to acceptable levels.

Similarly where work activities can have an adverse impact upon the environment, and particularly where there are legal requirements, employees will understand those impacts and the controls they must ensure are applied.

Employees need to be aware that for some craft and operational roles that work at height, or use fall arrest devices, there is an upper weight limit of 116Kg due to maximum safe working load of the safety equipment that is used.
If in doubt ask!
We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and able to be themselves.

All recruitment decisions are made by trained employees using human judgement and oversight.
Where applicable, this role is subject to safer recruitment processes and robust pre‑employment checks
These tools help us manage applications more efficiently and consistently, but they do not make hiring decisions.
We are committed to using AI responsibly, fairly and transparently, in line with our legal, regulatory and ethical obligations.
Your data will be hosted within a secure environment and will only be used by UK Power Networks for the purpose of which it is intended.

The data is used only as an input to provide insights for the screening process and is not retained by the model or by UK Power Networks’ contractor, shared with the contractor’s other customers or with OpenAI, or used to train or improve AI models.
We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

manual_review: Help deliver an exceptional student experience across London Business School’s degree programmes.
The Role London Business School is seeking a highly organised and service-focused Programme Administrator to support the delivery of its portfolio of degree programmes.

Working with Programme Managers, Senior Programme Managers and Programme Directors, you’ll help ensure students and colleagues receive accurate, timely and responsive support throughout the programme journey.
You’ll be part of a collaborative Degree Programmes team, supporting students from a wide range of backgrounds and countries.
The role combines student-facing service with programme administration, event support, learning delivery and financial administration.
Some evening and weekend work is required to support programme activity;
Main Responsibilities Coordinate the shared Student Support inbox, allocate enquiries and respond promptly and accurately to student requests.
Coordinate the Graduate Master’s mentoring programme, matching students with mentors across programmes.
Help deliver programme events and activities, including orientation, exchange activities, speaker events, Congregation and examination boards.
process invoices and expense claims and support budget tracking.
Work collaboratively across the School, support colleagues and contribute ideas to improve processes, systems and service delivery.
Who We Are Looking For Further education or an equivalent qualification.
Proficiency in commonly used IT packages, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel;
Proficient in commonly used IT packages such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and
experience with database systems is important, and PowerPoint is an advantage.
PowerPoint experience an advantage
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and responsive approach to customer service.
Strong organisational skills, meticulous attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
Confidence working under pressure, prioritising workload and supporting multiple programmes and stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work under pressure and prioritise workload
A collaborative team player who also takes ownership and responsibility for their work.
An understanding of project timelines and the importance of accurate data, reliable processes and a consistently high standard of support.

Benefits You Can Enjoy Generous annual leave of 27 days plus extra between Christmas and New Year Enrolment into the Group Pension Scheme Free onsite gym and swimming pool Amazing range of professional development to support your career path Enhanced cycle to work scheme Wellbeing offering to support your physical, mental and financial health Up to 5 days volunteering leave At London Business School, we support Smart Working - a hybrid approach designed to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance while delivering the best outcomes for your role and the needs of our customers.
All roles require a minimum of two days on campus each week to foster a vibrant, collaborative community.

We are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone in our community feels they belong and thrive.

programmes, which includes the MBA, a suite of Executive MBA programmes
(London -based, Dubai -based, E MBA -Global with Columbia Business School and
EMBA -Global Asia with Columbia and HKU), the Sloan Masters in Leadership and
Strategy, the Masters in Finance (full        -time and modular) and the       Graduate Masters
programmes comprising Masters              in Management       , Masters in Analytics and
Management, and Masters in Financial Analysis              .
The Degree Programmes portfolio
represents over 50% of London Business School’s revenues.
The department also plays
an essential role in supporting the School’s brand and reputation.
Job Purpose
To contribute to a high      -quality and rigorous experience for our students and to
help deliver a high     -quality degree programme by providing accurate, reliable,
timely, responsive and innovative service.
Ensure all students and colleagues in the
You will be working in a cross -programme role         , supporting the delivery of        all degree
programmes , assisting the Pro      gramme Managers          , Senior Managers and
Programme Director     s .
Student relationships are key in this role, and you’ll meet a
hugely diverse student      body from many different backgrounds and countries.
As part of the wider Degree Programmes               division, you will   be part of a supportive
and hard -working team, in an environment where everyone is                    encouraged to
constantly generate ideas and improve our service to the students.
You will have
the opportunity to also be involved in collaborative, cross             -programme activities to
support the wider delivery of all Degree Programmes.
Due to the nature of our programmes, the role requires some out of hours working
in evenings and weekends.
Time off in lieu is given for these hours.
Key areas of accountability:
Cross programme Student Support Desk
For all Degree Programmes,         lead on key student support       with 1 other programme
administrator, and supported by 2 further programme administrators, for Student
Support Desk tasks including:
Manage shared SSD inbox with 3 other programme administrators, ensuring
tasks are allocated fairly and all inbox queries are responded to in a timely
fashion
Produce student letters as and when required, ensur                 ing all the templates are
up to date for each new programme / academic year
Respond to all degree verification requests promptly and accurately
Process name badges, name plates and business card orders
attendance queries.
Process student requests for TLF and other rail cards
Manage merchandise ordering
Support with office management, including ordering of                    stationery , providing
meeting support, event organisation, stocking kitchen etc.
Ensure the Student Support Manual is up to date
Student Experience
students at all times
responding in a professional and timely manner to address queries or escalate
as required to ensure effective resolution.
Be alert to student welfare issues and escalate to the relevant Programme
Managers as necessary.
Contribute to the development of the student experience through engaging
building effective working relationships with the students.
communications) as directed by programme managers.
Manage the mentoring programme project, matching Graduate Master
students to mentors across all other programmes.
Learning Delivery Support
Support the student        business project submission process working with
Programme Manager          s and Senior Programme Manager               s across
programmes.
Provide administration support for            any programme elements where additional
delivery support is required.
Administration      and event support
day, responding to student queries
Provide administrative support to the Programme Team in the organisation of
Programme events           and activities where additional delivery support is required
(e.g.
including but not limited to Orientation, exchange activities, speaker
events, Congregation, Exam board)
Provide administrative support           as needed for meetings including room
documents for circulation
Analysis & Reporting
requirements and any other requirements we need to adhere to e.g.
next of kin,
address checks etc
Process invoices and expense claims and track them as required
Collaboration and Support
stakeholder experience.
Provide support to colleagues within and outside of the team as and when
opportunities arise, to promote collaborative working across the School.
Act as a point of referral for less experienced colleagues to help to resolve
issues and problems within the team.
Financial Management
Accurately process invoices and input financial data into systems to support the
tracking of team/department budgets
Process Improvement
Proactively review relevant processes and systems within own area of work
and make suggestions to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Change Management
Champion change by role modelling the behaviour expected from all colleagues,
and follow through on new activities or actions brought about change to help
support its successful implementation
KPIs:
Timely response to and resolution of enquiries, requests and issues.
Accuracy and integrity of data in business systems.
Development of relationships within and outside the team, and positive feedback
from colleagues.
Contributions to process reviews and operational improvements.
Knowledge/Qualifications/Skills/Experience required
Further education or equivalent qualification

Excellent interpersonal and relationship skills and the ability to address a
variety of stakeholders.
Excellent organisation skills and meticulous attention to detail
A team player who can work collaboratively, and also takes ownership and
responsibility for their work
Displays a proactive approach to tasks, suggesting improvements and
solutions

sources.text: We are looking for a Housing Options Team Leader (Accommodation) to lead our temporary accommodation service and play a key role in delivering high-quality homelessness services.

manual_review: Are you an experienced housing professional with a passion for preventing homelessness and supporting people to secure safe and suitable accommodation?
Do you have the leadership skills to motivate and develop a high-performing team in a fast-paced and rewarding environment?

You will be responsible for managing and developing a team, ensuring statutory homelessness duties are met, overseeing the provision of suitable temporary accommodation, and driving service improvements that deliver excellent outcomes for residents.
You will work closely with colleagues across Housing Services, support complex decision-making, manage performance, and help shape the future development of the service.
We are looking for someone with:
experience of managing and developing a busy team
excellent communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills
q) To positively and creatively lead your team through organisational and legislation changes.
record keeping and time management
experience of working to challenging targets and deadlines

In return, we offer a rewarding role where you can make a real difference to vulnerable households, alongside opportunities for professional development, a supportive management team and a commitment to flexible and modern ways of working.
Crawley is an exciting place to work with an open, friendly and welcoming culture.
The council is passionate about Crawley and works together through a One Team approach to achieve the best outcomes for our residents, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
If you are an enthusiastic leader who can combine technical expertise with a passion for service excellence, we would love to hear from you.
Crawley is a great place to work, with a thriving business district and excellent transport connections including nearby Gatwick Airport.
We are based in our modern Town Hall which opened in 2023 and is located a short walk from the town centre and railway station.
Additional information
This role participates in the delivery of our out of hours telephone service on a rota basis on standby category B at a fixed £1,039.95 per annum
A Baseline Personnel Security Standard check is required as part of this role, and that will also entail the successful applicant undertaking a Basic DBS Check.
Casual car user
Interviews will be held in person.
Employee benefits
We offer a generous employee benefits package, with a range of discounts, benefits and wellbeing incentives to suit everyone.
At Crawley Borough Council, you will have access to a structured programme of learning from day one, designed to help you succeed in your role and grow your career.
Local government reorganisation
Local government reorganisation (LGR) is planned across Sussex, with new unitary authorities expected by 2028.
While this represents a significant change for councils, most roles will continue to focus on delivering vital services to our residents and business communities.
As the future structure evolves, our name may change, but our commitment to providing excellent services and supporting our employees will not.
Joining us now means being part of a dedicated team during an important and evolving time for local government.
Our way of working
Our shared values and behaviours reflect the special nature of our council.
We encourage all colleagues to put them into practice, whatever job they do.
Take a look to see if we are the perfect match.
Safer recruitment
Crawley Borough Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.
We want to be an inclusive and diverse employer of first choice reflecting the community we serve and particularly welcome applications from all under represented groups.
JOB DESCRIPTION
DIVISION:        Strategic Housing Services
SCALE:           I/J (Career Grade)
ANY SPECIAL CONDITIONS:
(a) Career Grade
Scale I     - Postholder able to carry out the majority of all duties of the post, but requiring additional
Scale J     - Postholder able to carry out full duties of the post with minimal supervision.

(c) A Baseline Personnel Security Standard check is required as part of this role, and that will also entail the
successful applicant undertaking a Basic DBS Check.
MAIN PURPOSE OF SERVICE:
The main purpose of the homelessness service is to prevent and relieve homelessness by providing advice,
support and practical assistance to people who are at risk of losing their home or who have already become
homeless.
The service works with individuals and families to assess their housing needs, identify suitable
accommodation options, and help them access housing, financial support and other essential services.
Its
aim is to ensure that people have access to safe, suitable and sustainable accommodation, while promoting
independence, wellbeing and long-term housing stability.
MAIN PURPOSE OF POST:
To be responsible for the delivery of the temporary accommodation service, organising work, managing,
To work across other homelessness service areas and teams as required in maximising efficiency and
capacity to meet service demands.
SPECIFIC DUTIES OF POST:
Specific duties of the post
a) To participate in the recruitment and lead on the induction and training of new colleagues into the team
that you manage.
b) To manage and lead your team on the day- to-day operational functions of the service to ensure the
discharge of the Council’s statutory housing functions in the areas of Homelessness Prevention,
Relief, s184 Homeless Decisions, Homeless Accommodation and s202 Reviews.
c) Ensure that all duties are carried out in compliance with current legal and corporate requirements.

decisions issued, suitability of temporary accommodation placements and final offer discharges within
statutory deadlines.

has a duty to do so in the most cost effective way
g) To ensure temporary accommodation utilised meets required standards
h) To ensure the effective collection and recovery of temporary accommodation costs
to meet service demand and in the procurement of new temporary accommodation as required.

are successfully delivered and that personal housing plans and s184 decisions are legally robust and
of a consistently high standard.
n) Monitor and manage the casework levels for your team to ensure they are equally distributed and

sources.text: This is an exciting opportunity to join a high performing procurement team which provides strategic and technical procurement advice and tender management services to Crawley Borough Council, Horsham District Council, Mid Sussex District Council and, until March 2027, Mole Valley District Council.
We are looking for an individual to join the team in the role of Procurement Officer, with the opportunity to progress into the role as a Senior Procurement Officer.
You will be responsible for delivering a programme of procurements, including large-scale contracts, open tenders and mini-competitions through framework agreements.
You should have experience managing procurement processes from planning through to contract award and implementation, as well as developing effective tender documentation and evaluation criteria.

manual_review: We are looking for an enthusiastic, flexible and resilient individual who thrives on challenge, has a strong desire to continually improve practice, and who can deliver an excellent customer focused service.
In order to be successful, you will need to be an innovative, clear thinker with the ability to work with a team to deliver a project on time.
You’ll need excellent inter-personal and influencing skills.
It is vital that you are a team player and happy to help and support others.
This is a busy service with often changing priorities, so you will need to be well organised, resilient and adaptable.
You will be working in a fast-paced environment ensuring the smooth delivery of multiple procurement projects at any given time.

This is varied and interesting role with opportunities to work with senior leaders and to build experience across a broad range of category areas, including professional services, construction and regeneration, facilities management, waste, community and culture, corporate resources, IT and fleet.
The head office location is at Crawley Borough Council;

however, you will be situated between all of the shared service locations (which also includes Horsham, Haywards Heath and, until March 2027, Dorking) depending on the projects that you are assigned to and team needs.
Additional information
Employee benefits
We offer a generous employee benefits package, with a range of discounts, benefits and wellbeing incentives to suit everyone.
At Crawley Borough Council, you will have access to a structured programme of learning from day one, designed to help you succeed in your role and grow your career.
Local government reorganisation
Local government reorganisation (LGR) is planned across Sussex, with new unitary authorities expected by 2028.
While this represents a significant change for councils, most roles will continue to focus on delivering vital services to our residents and business communities.
As the future structure evolves, our name may change, but our commitment to providing excellent services and supporting our employees will not.
Joining us now means being part of a dedicated team during an important and evolving time for local government.
Our way of working
Our shared values and behaviours reflect the special nature of our council.
We encourage all colleagues to put them into practice, whatever job they do.
Take a look to see if we are the perfect match.
Safer recruitment
Crawley Borough Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.
We want to be an inclusive and diverse employer of first choice reflecting the community we serve and particularly welcome applications from all under represented groups.

This role provides high-quality administrative support for the School’s full-time and part-time Masters in Finance programmes, helping ensure the smooth delivery of programme activities and an excellent student experience.

You will work closely with students, faculty, practitioners and professional services colleagues, supporting programme operations through accurate administration, clear communication, event coordination and responsive student support.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

manual_review: This is a flexible and varied position, where priorities may change depending on the needs of the business.
You will have the opportunity to work alongside different departments, gain an understanding of how the company operates and gradually take on additional responsibilities.
We are particularly interested in finding someone who enjoys problem-solving, embraces new technology and can help us continue improving the way we work.
Assist the purchasing team with routine orders, including PPE, consumables and general site requirements.
Monitor pricing, order progress and deliveries to ensure goods arrive within required timescales.
Develop knowledge of the purchasing function, with the opportunity to take on more responsibility as experience and confidence grow.
Systems, Technology & Business Improvements
Help maintain and update internal systems, including Monday.com and Construction Manager.
Assist with implementing new software and improving existing systems and processes.
Explore opportunities to use AI, automation and technology to improve efficiency.
Help identify ways to streamline processes, reduce unnecessary administration and improve how information is managed across the business.
Provide flexible administrative support across different departments, helping colleagues with workloads, deadlines and ongoing projects.
Assist with general office administration and ad-hoc tasks as required.
What We Need From You
Excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
We are more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, strong organisational skills and the ability to learn and develop.
Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
A proactive, resourceful attitude and the confidence to use your own initiative.
An interest in technology, AI and improving business processes.
The ability to learn new systems quickly and adapt to different tasks.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to support colleagues across the business.
Experience & Skills
Previous experience in an administrative, finance, purchasing or operational support role would be beneficial.
Knowledge of the construction industry, purchasing processes or business management software would be an advantage, but is not essential, as training will be provided.
The Opportunity
This is not a role limited to one department or a fixed set of tasks.
You will become an integral part of our office team, supporting different areas of the business and helping to keep things running smoothly.
As your knowledge of the company develops, there will be opportunities to take greater ownership of tasks, particularly within purchasing, systems and business administration.
We are looking for someone who enjoys being busy, takes pride in their work and wants to contribute ideas and improvements as the business continues to grow.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Location: In person, Handcross, West Sussex
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
No recruitment agencies, please.
Direct applicants only.

extraction_audit.source: About the role
extraction_audit.reason: Published duties heading

extraction_audit.source: We currently operate two cemeteries, Little Trees Cemetery near Pease Pottage and Snell Hatch Cemetery, and 20 allotment sites throughout the town.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: As Cemeteries and Allotments Assistant your main focus will be to support our Allotments Officer in the upkeep and maintenance of our 20 allotment sites.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: In addition, you will be working as part of a small team responsible for the day-to-day operation of both cemetery sites.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: Duties at the allotment sites will include:
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: strimming

extraction_audit.source: repairs and maintenance within the communal areas

extraction_audit.source: meeting contractors for repairs or maintenance including compliance checks
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: Duties at the cemeteries will include:
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: compassion for families and friends of the deceased
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: preparing and back-filling graves

extraction_audit.source: maintaining the high-quality landscaped grounds
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: Therefore, it would be advantageous if you have proven experience of using plant machinery, hedge cutters, strimmer and ride on mowers.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: The role involves using hand and power tools, as well as operating a small 360 degree digger and dumper.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: The successful candidate will need experience of operating this equipment, relevant certification, or a willingness to undertake training and gain certification within six months of the agreed start date.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: You will also need to be confident driving the allotments tipper truck and trailer, training dependant.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: Our current fleet is 3.5 tonne Vauxhall Movano tipper with towing capability.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: You will need to have very good verbal communication skills and a high degree of emotional intelligence and empathy to deal with customers and the public appropriately.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: In return, we offer the exciting opportunity to be part of a dedicated team providing excellent cemetery and allotment provision, excellent working conditions and pension scheme.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: You will need to be comfortable working alone and as part of a team when undertaking the daily duties.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

sources.text: We currently operate two cemeteries, Little Trees Cemetery near Pease Pottage and Snell Hatch Cemetery, and 20 allotment sites throughout the town.

criteria.source: As Cemeteries and Allotments Assistant your main focus will be to support our Allotments Officer in the upkeep and maintenance of our 20 allotment sites.
criteria.label: Published duty / criterion — manual review

sources.text: As Cemeteries and Allotments Assistant your main focus will be to support our Allotments Officer in the upkeep and maintenance of our 20 allotment sites.

manual_review: We currently operate two cemeteries, Little Trees Cemetery near Pease Pottage and Snell Hatch Cemetery, and 20 allotment sites throughout the town.
As Cemeteries and Allotments Assistant your main focus will be to support our Allotments Officer in the upkeep and maintenance of our 20 allotment sites.
In addition, you will be working as part of a small team responsible for the day-to-day operation of both cemetery sites.
Duties at the allotment sites will include:
strimming
grass cutting
clearance of plots
repairs and maintenance within the communal areas
meeting contractors for repairs or maintenance including compliance checks
Duties at the cemeteries will include:
compassion for families and friends of the deceased
marking out
digging
preparing and back-filling graves
maintaining the high-quality landscaped grounds
Therefore, it would be advantageous if you have proven experience of using plant machinery, hedge cutters, strimmer and ride on mowers.
The role involves using hand and power tools, as well as operating a small 360 degree digger and dumper.

The successful candidate will need experience of operating this equipment, relevant certification, or a willingness to undertake training and gain certification within six months of the agreed start date.
Our current fleet is 3.5 tonne Vauxhall Movano tipper with towing capability.
You will need to have very good verbal communication skills and a high degree of emotional intelligence and empathy to deal with customers and the public appropriately.
In return, we offer the exciting opportunity to be part of a dedicated team providing excellent cemetery and allotment provision, excellent working conditions and pension scheme.
You will need to be comfortable working alone and as part of a team when undertaking the daily duties.
Additional information
Required to participate as part of a standby rota for Saturday burials, for which an additional payment is made.
Satisfactory clearance of a basic disclosure and barring service (DBS) check will be a condition of employment.
Employee benefits
We offer a generous employee benefits package, with a range of discounts, benefits and wellbeing incentives to suit everyone.
At Crawley Borough Council, you will have access to a structured programme of learning from day one, designed to help you succeed in your role and grow your career.
Local government reorganisation
Local government reorganisation (LGR) is planned across Sussex, with new unitary authorities expected by 2028.
While this represents a significant change for councils, most roles will continue to focus on delivering vital services to our residents and business communities.
As the future structure evolves, our name may change, but our commitment to providing excellent services and supporting our employees will not.
Joining us now means being part of a dedicated team during an important and evolving time for local government.
Our way of working
Our shared values and behaviours reflect the special nature of our council.
We encourage all colleagues to put them into practice, whatever job they do.
Take a look to see if we are the perfect match.
Safer recruitment
Crawley Borough Council is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment.
We want to be an inclusive and diverse employer of first choice reflecting the community we serve and particularly welcome applications from all under represented groups.

manual_review: Salary: £25,550 to £27,000 – (dependent on experience)

The Shared Service Centre (SSC) at the Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) provides a range of services that underpin the UK’s Aviation Safety framework and is the starting point for so many CAA processes where the first line of regulatory control and safety regulation begins at the application stage.
We handle the applications for most of the licences, certificates, approvals, permits and permissions that the CAA issues.
You'll be surprised at the technical expertise, insight, and knowledge you can learn on the job and in time, find yourself advising and guiding others on specialist subjects.
We need people who are great team players with a collaborative approach, able to work in an environment of change and are comfortable with switching focus depending on workload demands.
As this is a high-paced environment, you will need to be proactive, not afraid of challenges and willing to go the extra mile to ensure the delivery of tasks and deadlines are met.
IT skills in a range of Microsoft packages and using bespoke databases and systems are essential as well as the ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
What Can We Offer You?
We are focused on the development of our people, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside creative and collaborative team members who are keen to make a difference to the CAA.
Additional Information
For many appointments within the CAA, these roles require access to operationally sensitive infrastructure and/or Nationally Protected information.
For these roles the post holders must undergo National Security Vetting and achieve the appropriate level of clearance.
BPSS - To be vetted you must have the right to work in the UK so that meaningful checks can be undertaken.
If you do not meet these requirements, we may not be able to accept your application.
For more information on BPSS clearance please visit - BPSS clearance
The CAA values high ethical standards and personal integrity among employees.
If invited for interview you will be asked to complete a declaration of interest.
Relocation & Property
The CAA will be relocating from Aviation House (Our Gatwick Office) to new premises in a few years’ time.
Our move is driven by strategic, operational and environmental considerations.
We will be moving to a new local home, up to a 15-mile radius of Aviation House, to minimise disruption for our valued colleagues and customers.
We are now working with colleagues and visitors to understand what we need in our new office, before we start our property search.
We will sell Aviation House and land, vacate the site and move to new premises, but we do not expect to move before 2028
Inclusive Recruitment
If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
Use of Artificial Intelligence by candidates in the CAA recruitment process
No recruitment agencies please.

We recognise that many of our candidates find Artificial Intelligence to be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience.
Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be rejected on that basis.
Working With Us
Explore What We Offer section on our careers website to find out about our benefits and how we support work-life balance.
Our Values
Do The Right Thing, Never Stop Learning, Build Collaborative Relationships, Respect Everyone – For more information please Click Here

extraction_audit.source: The opportunity
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: We are seeking a motivated and dynamic individual to lead a Programme Administration team, providing key administrative support and record maintenance for a specified portfolio of courses, in accordance with the procedures and regulations of UAL.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: Based at London College of Fashion’s Eastbank site, you will manage a team of Programme Administrators, overseeing the provision of relevant administrative support for all courses within your portfolio of programmes, ensuring an excellent and high-quality service delivery and a seamless student experience, from the point of enrolment through to graduation.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: A key part of the role will involve working alongside academics with essential tasks such as monitoring student attendance, exam boards and assessments, course documentation as well as quality processes.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: About you
extraction_audit.reason: Candidate criteria heading

extraction_audit.source: The ideal candidate will have experience in key aspects of Further or Higher Education student administration, including registry processes such as enrolment and assessment.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: You will have an enthusiasm for creating a good student experience and be able to evidence strong leadership and line-management skills, with the ability to set clear objectives and motivate your team.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: You will be organised and able to plan a busy workload, communicating with colleagues in your team and key stakeholders.
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.source: If you have any general questions or have accessibility needs, please contact AGstaffrecruitment@arts.ac.uk
extraction_audit.reason: Source retained. Category matches do not certify complete interpretation of every clause.

extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context heading

extraction_audit.source: We operate a fair and open anonymous selection process.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: Thus, you will need to create an account and submit an application through our job board.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: As part of this, you will need to provide a supporting statement to demonstrate your suitability.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: Our recruitment process involves: application, shortlisting, assessment/interview, offer, onboarding.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: We understand the benefits of using AI in work.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: But, if you are thinking of using it to submit an application, we ask you to think about what value it adds.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: AI tools tend to lack the personal touch and authenticity we value in candidates.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: We encourage you to showcase your unique knowledge and skills using your own voice.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early if we receive a high level of interest.
extraction_audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

extraction_audit.source: We will aim to give at least 24 hours' notice of any changes to the closing date.
